newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss mountain cable car plunge injures 10.
newsitem.headline: Swiss mountain cable car plunge injures 10.

text.p: Around 10 people were hurt, some badly, when several gondolas on a Swiss mountain cable car crashed to the ground on Saturday, police said.
"It was around 10 people, including some who were seriously injured," said Carlo Kuonen, police spokesman in the southwestern canton of Valais. The accident was blamed on a malfunction.
Victims were flown by helicopter to hospitals in the area after the accident on the Riedleralp around 0900 GMT.
An investigation into the exact cause was under way.
